title: Repair promotion bootstrap when rollback root already exists

changes.summary: In materialize_immutable_rollback_runtime, check if destination exists; if it is a directory matching head_commit, tracked_tree_identity, accepted_dev_commit, and repository_slug, reuse its CandidateRuntimeIdentity instead of raising ValueError.
Added unit test verifying that calling materialize_immutable_rollback_runtime when destination already exists reuses the directory when identity matches.
